checks.details: Correct sequential fixture passed; injected fault failed simulation as expected; repaired fixture passed.
Icarus 12 compilation and simulation passed; 4655 output comparisons.

limitations: Development PASS is not official evaluation correctness; official evaluation has not been accessed or run.
Power-up behavior before synchronous reset and unknown-valued input behavior are unspecified by the original problem and are not asserted by the testbench.
No synthesis, timing, or board verification performed, as required.

implementation.interface_cycle_contract: Original one-bit ports; synchronous active-high reset to A; transitions on positive clk edges; combinational Moore output high only in D.
implementation.numeric_widths: Two-bit enum for four states; no arithmetic.
implementation.latency: No extra output latency or added handshake.
implementation.static_review: Complete transition table, explicit enum if/else assignments, one sequential state driver, no inferred combinational latch, no DUT initialization.
implementation.coverage: All eight state/input transitions; all 256 length-eight binary input sequences; reset from every state; repeated reset; inter-edge reset pulse; input changes between edges.
